registry: AIUC-1 controls cited by catalog mappings
purpose: Machine-readable record of every AIUC-1 control that catalog/mappings.json cites, so a new AIUC-1 release can be rechecked control by control. For each control: a subject in this project's own words (not AIUC-1 text), whether AIUC-1 lists it as a core or supplemental control, and the AIUC-1 release it was last checked against. For each cited requirement: the capabilities it is scoped to. scripts/validate.py rejects a cited control that is missing here, an entry that nothing cites, and a justification whose opening 'Core control' or 'Supplemental control' disagrees with the status; it warns while a control's release differs from the mapped release.
method: Read from each cited requirement page of the July 15, 2026 release: a control listed among the controls a requirement should include is core, one listed among those it may include is supplemental. Capabilities are the requirement's capability tags; Universal applies to every assessed product.
recheck: For each new AIUC-1 release: confirm every control below still exists under the same requirement with the same subject and status, update status, capabilities and release, renumber or remove entries the release changed, then fix every validator error in catalog/mappings.json. AIUC-1 allows up to 30 days of grace after a release for audits against the previous version.
